column2: a written rule that nothing enforces at the point it applies

a gate satisfied by the presence of a field rather than its content
a view tree rebuilt and laid out on every show though its input did not change
a reading taken before the thing read is ready, reported as its answer
one report for two states, so the reader is told the wrong one
a statistic compared against one estimated on a different sample size
a window signature that two states share, read as one of them
a restore that reads the value to restore after the change it undoes
a sum judged as a max (an additive background compared with max() instead of subtracted)
a ceiling stored below the baseline it was derived from (a kept value paired with a new one)
a race the caller lost, surfaced as a crash instead of a reading (a window closed between list and capture)
scratch written to a shared directory that nothing takes back
a list restated by hand beside the registry it copies (instruments the census passes and refuses)
a window built for every show and dropped after it
a citation of a roadmap item outlives the item

a count judged finer than the background it is net of
a held surface timed by its appearing
a verdict about framing that never reads what is framed
a wire id compared across its type
a feature added to the composition root instead of its coordinator

a non-finite value from the OS reaching integer conversion
an AX read where the window list answers
a wait for an event that is served by a periodic tick

a verb that waits on main for a write its caller could wait for
a teardown that a signal can cut short
a surface that hands the icon service's image to a view per show
a detector whose own capture cost lands in the reading
a census row whose trigger does not perform the action it names
a record that writes a cell measured as an instrument, not a subject
an end-to-end detector that cannot name what it waited on
a hot numeric loop in Swift that every debug build (dev install, census, suite) runs at debug speed
one event delivered once per announcer rather than once per change
a ceiling recorded over a defect, which then guards the defect
a ceiling recorded under conditions the gate never judges it in
a warning about a judged number that omits the number
a "mark what is current" rule run when a notice is HEARD, racing the work the event caused

a cost rule applied at one writer instead of at the funnel every writer shares
a tree scan that walks into another checkout nested inside the tree
a resource sized to its source where every consumer is bounded by its destination
a test asserting a join that only holds while an asynchronous read happens to still be running
a shared filesystem name taken by unlink-then-bind, which lets a second starter strand a live owner
a control that makes a temporary directory and leaves it for the next run's audit
a measured interval that includes a step the report cannot see
a gate allowance set from one row's instrument step, below another row's
a command line sized by the number of test processes
a post-condition wired at two call sites of a shared step, so every other caller of the step ran without it
a capture taken after a fixed sleep, racing the asynchronous work whose result it captures
a pattern search over a large corpus per query, where a substring scan finds the few candidates first
a push-time refusal asked only after the long work the push follows
